prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. CACE school material N4: SUBJECT + ACTION + OBJECT. Create ONE friendly clear flat 2D educational drawing with clean outlines, no 3D of rabbit explaining a picture story in children's picture storybook with simple pictures, no words opened toward viewer, mouth open and pointing at simple picture inside book, no text. Exact Catalan target: CONILL + EXPLICAR + CONTE. The subject must visibly perform the action ON the specified object; make both recognizable. Humorous anthropomorphic animal or imaginary character, retain unmistakable species features. Exactly the natural number of limbs: quadrupeds have FOUR limbs TOTAL. Prefer an upright seated or standing pose with exactly TWO hind legs and TWO forelegs used as arms. Never three legs plus two arms, never four legs plus extra arms. Birds have exactly TWO wings and TWO feet, never a third wing/hand. Insects retain species features. Pure white seamless background, minimal essential supporting props only. Add second living character ONLY when the target object is that character, or essential to show a human body part; no bystanders. All relevant figures and objects fully inside frame with generous margins, entire composition centered occupying at most 70 percent of frame. Correct hands/paws and plausible physical contact. Friendly and suitable for primary school. Absolutely NO text, letters, numerals, logos, signatures, speech bubbles, music notes or watermark, including books, money and clothing. Single scene, not collage.
